channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds gains above 185.50 near nine-day EMA support
item.description: EUR/JPY edges higher after three days of losses, trading around 185.50 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency cross is holding above both the nine-day and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs), which reinforces a mildly bullish near-term bias.

item.title: Indian Rupee gains on Middle East peace hopes
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens higher against the US Dollar on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair corrects to near 96.34 from its two-month high of 96.76 posted on Monday, as fresh hopes of de-escalation in military aggression between the United States (US) and Iran have offered support to the Indian currency.

item.title: WTI declines toward $82.00 as traders digest US-Iran developments
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $82.00 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The WTI declines but remains near multi-week highs as traders continue to assess the developments surrounding the US-Iran conflicts.

item.title: Gold looks to build on strength beyond $4,050 as subdued USD demand counters Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on Asian session gains and spikes to a multi-day high above the $4,050 level in the last hour, though the upside seems limited.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Intraday positive move stalls ahead of 1.4100 confluence hurdle
item.description: The USD/CAD pair attracts buyers for the second straight day on Tuesday and recovers further from its lowest level since June 17, around the 1.4000 psychological mark touched the previous day.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC says it hit US military targets in Bahrain and Kuwait
item.description: The Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) said that it struck US military targets, including air defence systems in Bahrain and Kuwait, the Guardian reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains support amid financial hub plans, geopolitical tensions ease
item.description: USD/IDR continues its losing streak for the sixth successive day, trading around 17,940 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Gains ground above 113.50, bullish trend holds above 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 113.85 during the early European session on Tuesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) due to the interest rate differential between the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ).

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bears retain control below 200-SMA on H4; break of 1.1400 awaited
item.description: The EUR/USD pair is seen consolidating during the Asian session on Tuesday and trading just above the 1.1400 mark, or a four-day low touched the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen consolidates against US Dollar amid uncertainty over future of Middle East
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades flat against the US Dollar (USD) at around 162.50 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday, closer to its multi-decade high of 162.84.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8110 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: RBNZ Sectoral Factor Inflation Model holds steady at 2.7% YoY in Q2 2026
item.description: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) published its Sectoral Factor Model Inflation gauge for the second quarter of 2026, following the release of the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) by NZ Stats on Tuesday.

item.title: US CENTCOM: Latest strikes hit Iran’s military command centres and air defense systems
item.description: The US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced via a post on the social media platform, X, that they completed the latest strikes at 1AM GMT Tuesday.

item.title: Japan PM Takaichi: Will guide economic, fiscal policy with due heed to fiscal sustainability
item.description: Japan Prime Minister (PM) Sanae Takaichi said during the Asian trading session on Tuesday that the government will guide economic and fiscal policy while paying close attention to fiscal sustainability and will focus on maintaining market trust.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds ground near 101.00 amid rising safe-haven demand
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is remaining in the positive territory and trading around 101.00 during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens above 0.7000 despite rising US-Iran tensions
item.description: The AUD/USD pair drifts higher to near 0.7010 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday. However, the potential upside for the pair might be limited amid the escalation of the US-Iran conflict. The Australian employment report will take center stage later on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound struggles as traders evaluate BoE policy, UK political developments
item.description: GBP/USD steadies after three days of losses, trading around 1.3430 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD bulls flirt with descending trend-line hurdle, above $57.00
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) attracts buyers for the third straight day and climbs back above the $57.00 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar rises above 0.5850 as hotter CPI data bolsters case for more RBNZ rate hikes
item.description: The NZD/USD pair attracts some buyers to around 0.5865 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) following hotter New Zealand inflation data.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7917 vs. 6.7948 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Tuesday at 6.7917 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7948 and 6.7706 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI slips below $82.00 as temporary diplomatic signals emerge
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends losses for the second successive day, trading around $81.90 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Oil prices decline as temporary diplomatic signals have emerged.

item.title: Canadian Dollar falls to one-week low vs USD on divergent BoC-Fed bets, Trump tariffs
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen buying on the previous day's solid rebound from the 1.4000 psychological mark, or its lowest level since June 17, and gaining positive traction for the second straight day on Tuesday.

item.title: Euro declines to near 1.1400 as US launches fresh strikes on Iran
item.description: The EUR/USD pair posts modest losses around 1.1410 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. Renewed tensions between the United States (US) and Iran continue to fuel risk-off sentiment, weighing on the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Singapore Dollar: CPI and MAS in focus – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong expect USD/SGD to remain largely driven by broader US Dollar (USD) direction and risk sentiment, after recent rangebound trading around the low‑1.29s.

item.title: US President Donald Trump to impose 50% tariff on some Canadian products
item.description: US President Donald Trump is imposing a new tariff of 50% on most Canadian products in response to what it called Canada's "discriminatory treatment" of US cars, alcohol, and dairy, according to the White House.

item.title: The Japanese Yen is stuck in a stalemate nobody can afford to break
item.description: USD/JPY changes hands near 162.50 on Monday after a session range of barely 40 pips, wedged between a floor just above 162.00 and a lid just beyond the half-handle.

item.title: The Australian Dollar keeps knocking on a door nobody opens
item.description: AUD/USD trades up around 0.2% on Monday and still cannot hold the figure that matters, climbing from near 0.6950 in early dealing, poking above the 0.7000 handle twice through the London and New York sessions, and getting sold back below it both times.

item.title: British Pound Sterling greets a new Prime Minister with a three-day slide
item.description: GBP/USD trades down around 0.17% on Monday and is on track for a third consecutive daily decline, fading from short of 1.3500 in the London morning to a New York probe just above the 1.3400 handle before steadying between the two.

item.title: US President Donald Trump vows Iran ‘will pay’ for US deaths
item.description: US forces struck Iranian targets after US President Donald Trump vowed Tehran “will pay” for killing three American soldiers, Bloomberg reported on Monday.
